resources.string: Reel counting arrives in a later version.
Counts the reels and shorts you scroll

Unrot uses this to see which app is open and, inside Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook and Snapchat, to count the reels and shorts you scroll. It never stores or sends what is on your screen: no text, captions, usernames or images.
Not connected. Turn on Unrot in Settings > Accessibility.
Turn on Unrot\'s accessibility service so it can see the reels and shorts you scroll.
Unrot is on but not running
Android stopped it. Tap below, then in Accessibility settings turn Unrot off and on again.
It\'s needed to see when you scroll reels and shorts in Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook and Snapchat, to show your live count, and to cover reels when you reach your limit.

To tell reels apart, Unrot reads screen structure (like the size of the scrolling area) and, for some apps, briefly reads on-screen text in memory. It never saves, logs, or sends any screen content. Only your reel counts and times are stored, on your phone.
If you join Friend Battles, only your daily count and failed challenges are shared with friends you add.
You can turn this off anytime in Android settings.
Next, Android opens Accessibility settings. Find Unrot (on some phones under Installed apps or Downloaded apps) and switch it on.
If the switch is greyed out: open App info → ⋮ menu → Allow restricted settings, then try again.
Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right, then Allow restricted settings, and confirm with your PIN or fingerprint if asked. Some phones name this menu differently.
Come back here, tap Turn on Unrot again and switch Unrot on.

Recording saves screen structure from Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook and Snapchat: class names, view ids, sizes and positions of scrolling lists, and a scrambled fingerprint of the reel in the middle. It never saves text, captions, usernames or images. Recordings stay on your phone until you share them.
Turn on Unrot first. Recording needs the accessibility service.

Now open the app and do exactly what the label says. Then come back here and tap Stop recording.
